info.title: Bitcoin++ API
info.description: Bitcoin++ public data and scoped account, talk, schedule, and recording API. OAuth access tokens and personal access tokens use the same scope and live-role checks.

get.description: Global-admin integration feed for stream schedulers. Results are ordered by updated_at. Pass the response meta.next_updated_after value on the next poll; updated_after is exclusive.

parameters.name: updated_after
parameters.description: Return plans changed strictly after this RFC 3339 timestamp.

put.summary: Start, heartbeat, or stop a recording broadcast
put.description: A live update also acts as a heartbeat. Send it at least once per minute; public playback stops advertising a live stream after two minutes without a heartbeat.

get.summary: Get a public project and teammates without email
List the PII-free merchandise inventory snapshot
get.description: Global administrators only. Includes inactive and archived variants needed for historical accounting.

Global administrators only. Combines merchandise order lines with canonical ticket registrations, includes each row's stable event identifier when applicable, reflects refunds, and exposes non-PII checkout identifiers for deterministic accounting reconciliation.

personalAccessToken.description: A personal access token. The endpoint's documented scope is still enforced.

scopes.identity:self:read: Read the resource owner's account ID, display name, and current roles
scopes.profile:self:read: Read the resource owner's private profile
scopes.profile:self:write: Update the resource owner's public profile
scopes.talks:write: Edit talks the resource owner speaks at
scopes.schedule:write: Manage schedules when live admin roles permit
scopes.recordings:write: Manage recording metadata when live admin roles permit
scopes.shop:accounting:read: Read PII-free shop inventory and sales when the resource owner is a global administrator
